1 · Intro

When to use it.

In Oracle, the job architecture lives on jobs, and jobs are attached to positions. Knowing which field is which keeps your positions and requisitions right.

Read Part 1 first for the terms.

Use this whenYou are setting up or reading a position and need to know how the job, job code, and job name work in Oracle.

2 · Walk through

How it shows up in Oracle.

Check off each item as you read.

Watch-outs

  • A requisition whose job code doesn't match the pre-search memo is sent back.
  • Open item: confirm how positions for students, postdocs, interns, affiliates, and contractors are set up until they are mapped to the job architecture.
  • Open item: confirm whether the University growth level is the same as the grade tied to compensation.

3 · Knowledge check

Check your understanding.

Three questions. You get feedback on each answer. All three right completes the course.

Q1How do a job code and a position number differ?

Q2A student position has no six-digit job code. What does that mean?

Q3What becomes the new hire's business title?

HCM Academy job aid · Hiring

Job Architecture overview, Part 2: How our job architecture is set up in Oracle

Use when: You are setting up or reading a position and need to know how the job, job code, and job name work in Oracle. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. Job codes and position numbers are different.
  2. Six-digit job codes are the job architecture.
  3. The job name carries its level.
  4. The job name becomes the business title.
  5. Skills come with the job.
  6. Pay ranges are tied to the job.

Watch-outs

  • A requisition whose job code doesn't match the pre-search memo is sent back.
  • Open item: confirm how positions for students, postdocs, interns, affiliates, and contractors are set up until they are mapped to the job architecture.
  • Open item: confirm whether the University growth level is the same as the grade tied to compensation.
